sn3.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn3.1:1.3: atha kho rājā pasenadikosalo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn3.1:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadikosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn3.1:1.5: bhavaṃpi no gotamo anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paṭijānātīti.
sn3.1:1.6: yaṃ hi taṃ mahārāja sammā vadamāno vadeyya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti mamantaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn3.1:1.7: ahaṃ hi mahārāja anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti.
sn3.1:2.1: yepi te bho gotama samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa seyyathīdaṃ
sn3.1:2.2: pūraṇo kassapo makkhali gosālo nigantho nāṭaputto sañjayo velaṭṭhaputto pakudho kaccāyano ajito kesakambalo
sn3.1:2.3: tepi mayā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paṭijānāthāti puṭṭhā samānā na anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paṭijānanti
sn3.1:2.4: kiṃ pana bhavaṃ gotamo daharo ceva jātiyā navo ca pabbajjāyāti.
sn3.1:3.1: cattāro khome mahārāja daharāti na uññātabbā daharāti na paribhotabbā
sn3.1:3.3: khattiyo kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo daharoti na paribhotabbo
sn3.1:3.4: urago kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo daharoti na paribhotabbo
sn3.1:3.5: aggi kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo daharoti na paribhotabbo
sn3.1:3.6: bhikkhu kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo daharoti na paribhotabbo
sn3.1:3.7: ime kho mahārāja cattāro daharāti na uññātabbā daharāti na paribhotabbāti.
sn3.1:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
sn3.1:14.1: evaṃ vutte rājā pasenadikosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn3.1:14.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
sn3.1:14.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn3.1:14.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
